title: Repeat-Vehicle and Stranger-Car Alert
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plate:detection
| stats count as sightings, earliest(_time) as first_seen by plate
| eval known=if(sightings>=5,"regular","infrequent"), brand_new=if(first_seen>relative_time(now(),"-1d"),1,0)
| where known="infrequent" AND brand_new=1
description: Flags vehicles seen on your street for the first time against the regulars, useful context for a quiet neighbourhood watch.
value: Distinguishing a new car from the daily regulars turns plate recognition into a gentle heads-up rather than constant noise.
implementation: Feed plate-recognition results into `index=personal`; alert on brand-new plates that are not among the regulars.
visualization: Table of newly seen plates with sighting counts.
grandmaExplanation: It learns which cars are regulars on your street and points out ones it has never seen before.
